findings.source_quote: οἱ δ’ ὑπὸ νόθου φύσεως τῷ καθαρῷ τῆς τροφῆς οὐκ ἀρεσκόμενοι, μόνης τῆς τῶν αἱμάτων γεύσεως ἐγλίχοντα.
findings.english_quote: But they, because of their illegitimate nature, not being pleased with the purity of the food, craving only the taste of blood.
findings.issue: The recognizable γλιχ- stem and dependent genitive support the sense of craving, but the surviving form ἐγλίχοντα has no established grammatical function in this construction. It is neither the regular third-person plural imperfect middle ἐγλίχοντο nor a nominative plural participle agreeing with οἱ ... ἀρεσκόμενοι. Rendering it as “craving” leaves an English fragment without establishing how the supplied verbal form functions. Thus the lexical material is represented, but complete, defensible coverage of the surviving clause cannot yet be certified. The notes disclose this problem honestly. The block concerns unresolved morphology and predication, not ordinary interpretive alternatives or uncertainty about the already image-checked print.
findings.suggested_revision: Retain the exact supplied reading and its disclosure. Obtain linguistic or textual evidence establishing a defensible construction for ἐγλίχοντα. If a correction to ἐγλίχοντο is supported, identify it explicitly as an emendation rather than the supplied reading; it would support a finite rendering such as “they craved only the taste of blood.” That proposed correction and revised English would require fresh review. Do not silently insert it or treat the present fragment as a resolved translation.
